items.content_text: As mentioned in the main post , Greasemonkey 4 is changing how it runs user scripts.  Many user scripts will continue to run as expected, but this will break some scripts.  If you rely on such scripts, you might want to install Violentmonkey or Tampermonkey , both of which provide better compatibility for existing scripts.
